issue.title: bob-mac-capture master Build fails since 906a7df: RefsCopyEntry not in scope in BobPanelCoordinator and a public HUD show() takes an internal style
issue.description:
bob-mac-capture master no longer compiles on macOS CI. 906a7df ("feat(refs): add Highlights code and link copy keys", agent 14k.w0, no bead) broke the Build step. Run 40439969638 on 906a7df and run 40457103786 on 9db33a6, which inherits the break, fail with the same three compile errors:

- Sources/BobMacCapture/BobPanelCoordinator.swift:139:44 cannot find type 'RefsCopyEntry' in scope. RefsCopyEntry is a public enum in RefsCore (Sources/RefsCore/RefsCopy.swift:1211), and BobPanelCoordinator.swift has no `import RefsCore`.
- Sources/BobMacCapture/Refs/RefsCopyHUD.swift:180:17 method cannot be declared public because its parameter uses an internal type. 906a7df added `public func show(title:value:detail:style:centeredOn:)` taking the internal `RefsGlassToastStyle`.
- Sources/BobMacCapture/AppDelegate.swift:180:70 cannot infer contextual base in reference to member 'card'. This is a knock-on of the first error.

Likely fix: add `import RefsCore` to BobPanelCoordinator.swift, and make the new `show(... style: ...)` overload internal (or the style enum public). Compile per bob-mac-capture AGENTS.md: `just portable-check`, then a scratch Mac `Scripts/bundle.sh` plus `just typecheck-tests`. The Mac was offline on 2026-10-27, so the batch-15 lander could not compile and did not land a fix.

Last green master run: 40407215560 on 2764ec5.

Acceptance: master macOS CI green on the fix SHA, with Build, Test, and bundle steps passing. The run must also pass batch-15's uncompiled Mac commit 9db33a6 (bob-cli-az: rename hint removed, retryable rename feedback), including RefsPanelModelTests.testRetryableCoordinationRenameErrorsRetainDraftAndDoNotAnnounceSuccess.
